judge_claim: The Optimal Weight algorithm assigns each LLM weight omega_i = sigma_K^{-1}(x_i), and Theorem 1 proves OW is Bayes-optimal among all aggregators with the same first-order accuracy information.

quantifiers.P: every post-shuffle joint distribution satisfying Proposition 1 and Assumption 1
quantifiers.answers: every observed answer profile in S^N

assumptions: The ground-truth label is uniform after random label shuffling.
Each agent is correct with probability x_i and spreads error uniformly across the K-1 wrong labels.
Agents are conditionally independent given the ground-truth label.
All x_i are strictly between zero and one so finite log-odds are defined.
acceptance: A machine-checked symbolic likelihood factorization proves equality of the complete OW and MAP argmax sets over the quantified domain.
An independently implemented exact-rational checker finds zero mismatches over every answer profile in a documented finite stress suite including below-chance and chance agents.
A negative control that preserves the marginals but violates conditional independence makes OW disagree with MAP for the intended reason.
The verifier exits nonzero if any proof step, exact checker, or control fails.
